title: AI-Guided Depression Treatment Pathways
tagline: From ward bottleneck to personalised antidepressant selection

milestones.label: Clinical challenge
milestones.detail: POWH psychiatrists flagged 6–8 week delays choosing second-line antidepressants after first-line failure.

milestones.label: Research match
milestones.detail: AI matched the challenge to a UNSW computational psychiatry team with treatment-response modelling expertise.

milestones.label: Pipeline project
milestones.detail: Feasibility study funded; model trained on de-identified SESLHD outcomes and entered the precinct pipeline at TRL 4.

milestones.label: Clinical validation
milestones.detail: Prospective pilot across two clinics reduced time-to-effective regimen by a median of 42 days.

milestones.label: Commercial outcome
milestones.detail: Licensed pathway tool adopted in mental health services; investor interest via RHIP Connect pipeline.

title: Liquid Biopsy Early Detection Platform
tagline: ctDNA screening that moves cancer detection earlier in the pathway

milestones.label: Clinical challenge
milestones.detail: Oncology teams needed earlier detection for high-risk patients without invasive tissue biopsy.

milestones.label: Research match
milestones.detail: Matched to a molecular diagnostics group with circulating tumour DNA assay capability.

milestones.label: Pipeline project
milestones.detail: Multi-cancer early detection platform entered pipeline; NHMRC-aligned validation plan drafted.

milestones.label: Clinical validation
milestones.detail: Prospective cohort study underway; sensitivity targets met for three priority tumour types.

milestones.label: Translation status
milestones.detail: TRL 7 — system prototype in operational environment; preparing health-system procurement brief.

title: Youth Early Psychosis Detection Tool
tagline: School and primary-care screening that shortens the path to care

milestones.label: Clinical challenge
milestones.detail: Adolescent mental health services reported late presentation of first-episode psychosis.

milestones.label: Research match
milestones.detail: Connected clinicians with digital screening researchers and youth mental health partners.

milestones.label: Pipeline project
milestones.detail: Digital tool deployed in school and GP pilots; entered pipeline at clinical readiness.

milestones.label: Clinical validation
milestones.detail: Referral-to-assessment time reduced by ~65 days in pilot sites.

milestones.label: Scale pathway
milestones.detail: District expansion plan under review; community outcome metrics linked on Government dashboard.
